verdict.rationale: Docs show a hosted Cloud Agent API (client.runs.create) that runs tasks without local browser management, with polling via runs.events() and cursor support for incremental updates; sessions/runs are managed server-side. Webhook support isn't explicitly confirmed and no official OpenAPI spec was found (404s), so missing for 10: explicit webhook delivery documentation, published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on confirmation of the hosted API workflow.
